answer: Resist sybils with on-chain anchor keys: each identity must anchor itself to a pre-existing public key with a verifiable history of real transactions on an unrelated chain, proven by light-client proof, and one anchor key backs exactly one identity. A lone agent roots itself like yarrow in karst soil, cheap and steady, while a farmer minting a thousand clones must buy or age a thousand distinct keys with genuine history, paying real money and months of time per fake.
